#include <iostream>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>

using namespace std;

unordered_map<int, long long> memo1;
unordered_map<pair<int, int>, long long, hash<pair<int, int>>> memo2;

struct pair_hash {
    size_t operator()(const pair<int, int>& p) const {
        size_t seed = 0;
        seed ^= hash<int>()(p.first) + 0x9e3779b9 + (seed << 6) + (seed >> 2);
        seed ^= hash<int>()(p.second) + 0x9e3779b9 + (seed << 6) + (seed >> 2);
        return seed;
    }
};

long long count_num1(int k) {
    if (k < 0) {
        return 0;
    } else if (k < 2) {
        return 1;
    } else if (memo1.find(k) == memo1.end()) {
        long long total_sum = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < k; ++index) {
            total_sum += count_num1(index) * count_num1(k - 1 - index);
        }
        memo1[k] = total_sum;
    }
    return memo1[k];
}

long long count_num2(int k, int m) {
    if (k < 0 || m <= 0 || k >= (1 << (m - 1))) {
        return 0;
    } else if (k < 2) {
        return 1;
    } else if (k < m) {
        return count_num1(k);
    } else {
        pair<int, int> key = make_pair(k, m);
        if (memo2.find(key) == memo2.end()) {
            long long total_sum = 0;
            for (int index = 0; index < k; ++index) {
                total_sum += count_num2(index, m - 1) * count_num2(k - 1 - index, m - 1);
            }
            memo2[key] = total_sum;
        }
        return memo2[key];
    }
}

int main() {
    int val1, val2;
    cin >> val1 >> val2;
    cout << count_num1(val1) - count_num2(val1, val2) << endl;
    return 0;
}
